criteria.requirement: Add optional callback(record) to anchors_plugin and the actual core anchor assignment path. Invoke once per selected heading after final unique slug assignment, supplying title before permalink injection, final slug, integer level and an independent map list or None. Callback records must match real rendered ids for duplicate titles/custom slug functions; changing a record/map must not mutate Token state. Keep default behavior, selected-level filtering and per-document uniqueness, do not repeat callback when rendering already parsed tokens, and propagate consumer exceptions explicitly. Do not simulate navigation by reparsing rendered HTML.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
